title: 第209章 剑冢之门第208章 秦明月
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
青色剑光从地缝中冲天而起。
整座擂台的青石板被剑光掀翻了大半，碎石炸上半空，又像下雨一样砸下来。秦无双一拳轰碎一块当头砸落的石板，碎石在他拳骨上炸成粉末，嘴也没闲着：“姐！你别打了——剑冢开了！”
秦明月和苏意同时收拳后退。
两人脚后跟在擂台上各自碾出半圈石粉，退了三步，站稳。秦明月的白色绑手带被剑光割破了三道口子，露出底下拳骨上层层叠叠的旧茧。苏意的矿奴服袖口也被剑光削掉了一截，断口整齐如刀割。
裂缝还在扩大。
从擂台中央往四面八方蔓延，每一道裂缝里都喷出那种极暗极深的青色剑光。剑光不是散的——是凝的。从地底深处射出来，像一把把看不见的剑在往天上刺。
裂缝深处露出一道斜插在地底的巨大石门。
石门高十丈，宽五丈，斜插在擂台正下方不知多深的地层里。门面上刻满了密密麻麻的剑痕，每一道剑痕都残留着极古老的剑意。剑意历经数千年不散，还在门面上缓缓流转，发出极细微极尖锐的嗡鸣。
石门正中央嵌着一柄剑。
剑身通体青碧，剑锷缺了一小块，剑格上刻着两个字——还情。
叶寒霜长剑出鞘。
不是她拔的剑——是剑自己从鞘中弹出了半寸。剑身在她手中剧烈震颤，剑尖指向石门中央那柄青碧长剑，剑意不受控制地从她身上散开，与石门上密密麻麻的剑痕产生共鸣。
“还情剑！”叶寒霜的剑瞳里第一次出现了震惊，“天剑阁祖剑——天剑阁历代剑主口传的创始人之剑！剑谱上记载这把剑在数千年前就已失传，创始人带着它去了天外天再也没回来。它怎么会在这里？”
季长风将还债剑从背后解下。
剑鞘上的矿奴工号在祖剑共鸣下全部亮起——甲零三，还有苏意后来刻上去的另外三百多个名字，每一个名字都在发光。暗金色的光芒沿着笔画纹路缓缓流动，和石门上那柄还情剑的青碧剑光交相辉映。
然后还债剑自己动了。
剑身从季长风手中飞出，在空中划出一道暗金色的弧线，直直飞向石门中央。还情剑也从石门上自行拔出，青碧剑光在空中与暗金剑光交错——
两把剑在石门正中央交叉悬停。
还情剑在上，还债剑在下。一青一金，一剑问一剑答。
两把剑同时发出极悠长极清越的剑鸣。剑鸣不是刺耳的——是低沉的，悠长的，像两个隔了数千年终于重逢的老友在低声交谈。

石门在剑鸣中缓缓向内打开。
门后是一座被青光照亮的剑冢。剑冢不算大，只有十丈见方，四壁都是未经雕琢的天然岩层，岩层上插满了锈迹斑斑的古剑。每一把剑都插得很深，剑身上的剑意早已散尽，只剩下铁锈和石粉混在一起的气息。
剑冢正中央的地面上插着一幅卷轴。
卷轴的材质不是纸，不是皮，不是妖兽皮——是一层极薄的剑意凝结体。剑意凝成实质之后被压缩到纸一样薄，然后卷起来插在地上，数千年来剑意不散。
苏意走进剑冢。
脚底板踩在剑冢地面上的瞬间，四壁上那些锈迹斑斑的古剑同时发出一声极轻微的震鸣——不是攻击，是认主。武道归宗令在他怀里微微发热，和剑冢里的剑意产生了某种极微妙的共鸣。
他把卷轴从地上拔起来，展开。
卷轴里是一封信。
字数不多，写得极简极短，每一个字都是用剑尖直接刻在剑意凝结体上的。笔画横平竖直，收笔处有极细微的剑芒残留——天剑阁创始人的字。
“吾以还情剑为信，君以还债剑为证。今结盟共守，以武道为基，以剑意为盾，誓守国术传承不灭。若有朝一日武道联盟覆灭，天剑阁便是最后的武道火种。”
落款处刻了两个名字。一个名字笔画凌厉如剑——天剑阁创始人，叶还情。另一个名字笔画沉凝如拳——武道联盟盟主，武归宗。
秦明月站在苏意身后，看完卷轴上每一个字。
然后她沉默了。
沉默了很久。
擂台上的风灌进剑冢，吹得四壁上那些锈剑发出极细微极空洞的呜咽声。
“秦家祖训说剑冢不能开，开了会出大事。”秦明月的声音不高，但每一个字都咬得很清楚，“我一直以为里面压着危险——压着秦家也对付不了的东西。所以我把擂台摆在正堂正上方，不是为了违抗祖训，是想压住它。我以为用擂台上的拳劲一层一层叠上去，就能把底下的东西压得更结实。”
她顿了顿。
“结果压在下面的不是危险，是一封信。”
秦无双走到她身边，胸口还缠着绷带，但脊背挺得笔直。
“姐，秦家祖先是武道联盟的后人，替联盟守着这封信和这座剑冢。天剑阁的剑意会与擂台上的拳劲共振触发剑冢开启条件——这不是巧合。这是联盟当年的设计：只有武修与剑修同时出现在擂台上，剑冢才会开启。秦家守了数千年，从没等到过天剑阁的剑修登门。今天苏意以咏春寸劲和你的寸劲对拳，擂台上的拳劲和剑意同时出现——剑冢第一次遇到开启条件。”

他转头看向苏意，又看向季长风和叶寒霜。
“所以不是灾祸。是时候到了。”
叶寒霜收剑入鞘。剑入鞘的瞬间，她周身剑意全部收敛，脸上第一次出现了一抹极淡的笑意。
“季长风，天剑阁的祖剑找到了。还情剑是创始人佩剑，还债剑是武道联盟盟主的回礼——一把问，一把答，两把剑同源同根。天剑阁重建，有根基了。”
content_en:
A green sword light soared into the sky from the crack in the ground.
Most of the bluestone slabs in the entire arena were overturned by the light of the sword, and rubble exploded into the air before falling down again like rain. Qin Wushuang smashed a stone slab that fell on his head with one punch, and the broken stone exploded into powder on his fist bones. He kept talking: "Sister! Stop fighting - the sword tomb is open!"
Qin Mingyue and Su Yi drew back their fists at the same time.
The two of them each crushed a half circle of stone powder with their heels on the ring, took three steps back, and stood firm. Qin Mingyue's white hand strap was cut three times by the sword light, revealing layers of old calluses on the fist bones underneath. The cuffs of Su Yi's mining slave uniform were also cut off by the sword light, and the cut was as neat as a knife.
The cracks are still widening.
Spreading from the center of the arena in all directions, the extremely dark and deep cyan sword light spurted out from every crack. The sword light is not scattered - it is condensed. It shoots out from the depths of the earth, like invisible swords stabbing into the sky.
A huge stone door slanted into the ground was revealed deep in the crack.
The stone gate is ten feet high and five feet wide. It is inserted diagonally into the ground at an unknown depth directly below the ring. The facade is covered with dense sword marks, and each sword mark retains the ancient sword intention. The sword intention has not dissipated after thousands of years, and is still slowly flowing on the facade, making a very subtle and sharp buzzing sound.
There is a sword embedded in the center of the stone door.
The sword body is all green and green, with a small piece of the sword missing. There are two words engraved on the sword grid - return love.
Ye Hanshuang unsheathed his long sword.
It wasn't her who drew the sword - it was the sword that popped half an inch out of its sheath. The sword body trembled violently in her hand, and the tip of the sword pointed at the long green sword in the center of the stone door. The sword intention spread out from her body uncontrollably, resonating with the dense sword marks on the stone door.
"Repay the Love Sword!" Shock appeared in Ye Hanshuang's sword eyes for the first time, "The Ancestral Sword of Tianjiange - the founder's sword passed down orally from successive sword masters of Tianjiange! The sword manual records that this sword was lost thousands of years ago. The founder took it to Tianwai Tian and never came back. Why is it here?"
Ji Changfeng took off the debt repayment sword from behind.
The miner numbers on the scabbard all lit up under the resonance of the ancestral sword - Jia Ling San, as well as more than 300 other names that Su Yi later engraved on it, each one of them glowed. The dark golden light flows slowly along the lines of the strokes, complementing the green and green sword light of the repaying sword on the stone door.
Then the Debt Repayment Sword moved on its own.
The sword flew out of Ji Changfeng's hand, drawing a dark golden arc in the air and flying straight to the center of the stone gate. The Sword of Return was also pulled out from the stone door on its own, and the green sword light intersected with the dark gold sword light in the air——
Two swords hovered crosswise in the center of the stone door.
The sword to repay love is at the top, and the sword to repay debt is at the bottom. One green and one gold, one sword asks and one sword answers.
The two swords simultaneously emitted a very long and clear sword cry. The sound of the sword was not harsh - it was low and long, like two old friends finally meeting again after thousands of years and talking in a low voice.
The stone door slowly opened inward amid the sound of swords.
Behind the door is a sword tomb illuminated by green light. The sword tomb is not big, only ten feet square. The four walls are made of uncarved natural rock formations, and the rock formations are covered with rusty ancient swords. Each sword was inserted very deep, and the sword intent on the sword had long since dissipated, leaving only the smell of rust and stone powder mixed with it.
There is a scroll inserted on the ground in the center of the sword tomb.
The material of the scroll is not paper, not leather, not monster skin - it is an extremely thin layer of sword energy condensation. After the sword intention was condensed into substance, it was compressed until it was as thin as paper, then rolled up and inserted into the ground. The sword intention remained intact for thousands of years.
Su Yi walked into the sword tomb.
The moment the soles of his feet stepped on the ground of the sword tomb, the rusty ancient swords on the four walls simultaneously let out a very slight vibration - not an attack, but a recognition of their master. The martial arts return order was slightly warm in his arms, and it had some very subtle resonance with the sword intention in the sword tomb.
He pulled the scroll up from the ground and unfolded it.
Inside the scroll is a letter.
Not many words, well writtenExtremely simple and short, every word is carved directly on the condensed body of sword intent with the tip of the sword. The strokes are horizontal and vertical, with a very slight sword glow remaining at the end of the stroke - the calligraphy of the founder of Tianjian Pavilion.
"I take the sword of repayment of love as my faith, and you take the sword of repayment of debt as proof. We have formed an alliance today, with martial arts as the foundation, sword intention as the shield, and vowing to protect the inheritance of national martial arts forever. If the martial arts alliance is destroyed one day, Tianjian Pavilion will be the last fire of martial arts."
Two names are engraved at the signature. The strokes of a name are as sharp as a sword - Ye Huanqing, the founder of Tianjian Pavilion. The strokes of another name are as dense as a fist - the leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, Wu Guizong.
Qin Mingyue stood behind Su Yi and read every word on the scroll.
Then she fell silent.
There was silence for a long time.
The wind from the arena poured into the sword tomb, causing the rusty swords on the four walls to make tiny and hollow whimpering sounds.
"The ancestral teachings of the Qin family say that the sword tomb cannot be opened. If it is opened, big trouble will happen." Qin Mingyue's voice was low, but every word was spoken clearly. "I always thought that there was danger inside - something that the Qin family couldn't deal with. So I placed the ring directly above the main hall, not to disobey the ancestral teachings, but to suppress it. I thought that using the strength of the ring's fists to stack them up layer by layer would make the things underneath stronger."
She paused.
"It turned out that what was underneath was not a danger, but a letter."
Qin Wushuang walked to her side, his chest was still bandaged, but his back was straight.
"Sister, the ancestors of the Qin family are descendants of the Martial Arts Alliance, and they are guarding this letter and this sword tomb for the alliance. The sword intention of Tianjian Pavilion will resonate with the fist power on the ring to trigger the conditions for opening the sword tomb - this is not a coincidence. This was the alliance's design at the time: only martial arts cultivators and sword cultivators are at the same time The sword tomb will be opened only after appearing in the ring. The Qin family has been guarding it for thousands of years and has never waited for the swordsman from Tianjian Pavilion to come to the door. Today, Su Yi used Wing Chun's inch strength to fight with your strength. The sword's strength and sword intention appeared at the same time in the ring - it was the first time that the sword tomb was opened. "
He turned to look at Su Yi, then at Ji Changfeng and Ye Hanshuang.
"So it's not a disaster. It's about time."
Ye Hanshuang sheathed his sword. The moment the sword was sheathed, all the sword intent in her body was restrained, and a faint smile appeared on her face for the first time.
"Ji Changfeng, the ancestral sword of Tianjian Pavilion has been found. The repayment sword is the founder's sword, and the debt repayment sword is a return gift from the leader of the Martial Arts Alliance - one question and one answer. The two swords have the same origin. The reconstruction of Tianjian Pavilion has a foundation."
